dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Visible gradual symmetrical narrowing of the lateral margins from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slight asymmetrical textural irregularities along the right lateral margin where the body meets the water surface; otherwise smooth.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Dark slate-grey median pixel intensity consistent with a juvenile or sub-adult phenotype.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: High density of lighter-grey linear streaks and diffuse patches across the entire visible dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slope between the dark grey baseline and the lighter surface mottling.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple sets of high-contrast, parallel linear marks (rake marks) and small dark point-contrast anomalies across the dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel linear scarring (rake marks) of varying orientations concentrated on the mid and posterior dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Clearly defined dark elliptical blowhole located at the anterior dorsal midline.
